entities.name: Trimethylsilyl ethynylisoquinoline
observations: Principal substrate decoded as C[Si](C)(C)C#Cc1ccc2cnccc2c1, a trimethylsilyl-protected ethynyl isoquinoline; likely 5-ethynylisoquinoline precursor.

entities.name: Ethynylisoquinoline
observations: Predicted major product is the terminal alkyne HC#Cc1ccc2cnccc2c1, commonly assignable as 5-ethynylisoquinoline.

entities.name: TMS alkyne desilylation
observations: K2CO3 in methanol/water is consistent with base-mediated cleavage of a trimethylsilyl-protected alkyne to form the terminal ethynyl heteroarene.

entities.name: K2CO3 MeOH H2O
observations: Reaction mixture contains dipotassium carbonate, methanol, and water; ethyl acetate is most plausibly workup or extraction solvent rather than an incorporated reagent.
